Senior Backend Engineer

Flywheel Systems · Remote (Europe)

Job Description

Flywheel Systems builds scheduling software for logistics companies. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design and maintain the services that move millions of shipment events every day.

You will own the ingestion service, keep the PostgreSQL schema healthy, improve observability and pair with two junior engineers twice a week. This is a remote role with a preference for candidates who can overlap with Central European working hours.

Requirements

  • Five or more years of professional Python experience.
  • Strong SQL and relational database design skills.
  • Experience running services on AWS or another cloud provider.
  • Comfortable writing tests, reviews and design documents.

About the company

Flywheel Systems is a forty-person company based in Berlin. We ship weekly, keep the on-call rotation humane and publish our engineering handbook publicly.
